issues.description: Public NAME constants downgraded to package-private break external consumers
issues.detail: Lucene99HnswScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat.NAME and Lucene99ScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat.NAME (plus QUANTIZED_VECTOR_COMPONENT and calculateDefaultConfidenceInterval) were public static final and are now package-private. Downstream code in Elasticsearch/OpenSearch and custom codecs commonly references these constants for SPI/named lookup, so this is a binary-incompatible break beyond a simple move.

issues.description: @Deprecated annotation removed during move to backward_codecs
issues.detail: Both Lucene99HnswScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat and Lucene99ScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat lost their @Deprecated annotations. Since these are now strictly read-only legacy formats replaced by Lucene104, retaining @Deprecated is more important than ever so downstream users see IDE/compiler warnings rather than discovering the restriction only at write time.

issues.description: Constructor still validates numMergeWorkers/mergeExec but discards them while writer throws UOE
issues.detail: Lucene99HnswScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat keeps the 7-arg constructor with numMergeWorkers/mergeExec validation, but the fields are no longer stored and fieldsWriter throws UnsupportedOperationException. Callers passing a valid executor pass validation, then hit a confusing late UOE. Either simplify the constructor to read-only or fail fast at construction.

issues.description: OffHeapQuantizedByteVectorValues protected fields demoted to package-private break external subclasses
issues.detail: Fields like dimension, size, scalarQuantizer, and slice were changed from protected to package-private while the class remains public abstract. External subclasses (plugins, tests) lose inheritance access and fail to compile. If lockdown is intended, the class itself should be sealed or made final.

issues.description: DIRECT_MONOTONIC_BLOCK_SHIFT duplicated rather than imported from Lucene99FlatVectorsFormat
issues.detail: A new static final int DIRECT_MONOTONIC_BLOCK_SHIFT = 16 is introduced locally rather than reusing the core constant. If the values drift, the legacy reader silently produces incompatible reads. Either import the original constant or add a comment pinning it to the v99 on-disk layout.

issues.description: CHANGES.txt entry inconsistencies around Lucene104 replacement claim and formatting
issues.detail: The CHANGES bullet references a Lucene104HnswScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat replacement that does not appear in the diff, edits an existing 15169 entry rather than adding a new bullet, and uses inconsistent continuation indentation. Verify scope wording and normalize formatting before merge.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this PR is a mostly-clean mechanical move of the Lucene99 scalar-quantized vector formats from core to backward_codecs, with writers stubbed to throw UnsupportedOperationException. The dominant concerns are API-surface regressions: public NAME constants and previously-protected fields on OffHeapQuantizedByteVectorValues were silently downgraded to package-private, breaking downstream consumers like Elasticsearch/OpenSearch. The @Deprecated annotations were dropped at the worst possible moment, removing the compile-time signal that these formats are read-only. The HNSW constructor retains numMergeWorkers/mergeExec validation but discards the values, producing late UOE failures. A duplicated DIRECT_MONOTONIC_BLOCK_SHIFT constant and a misleading CHANGES.txt entry round out the cleanup list.
